description: This file contains core initialization and loader functions for the Enyo JavaScript framework, including platform-specific functions, resource loading mechanisms, dependency management, and path configuration.

classes.name: enyo.machine
classes.description: Object managing resource loading, including stylesheets and scripts.

classes.name: enyo.loader
classes.description: Factory-created loader object responsible for dependency management and resource loading.

methods.name: enyo.execUnsafeLocalFunction
methods.description: Executes a function with restricted platform security considerations.

methods.name: enyo.machine.sheet
methods.description: Loads a stylesheet, handling CSS and Less files.

methods.name: enyo.machine.inject
methods.description: Injects JavaScript code directly into the document.

methods.name: enyo.depends
methods.description: Loads dependencies specified by script or style paths.

methods.name: enyo.load
methods.description: Queues and manages runtime loading of dependencies with callbacks.

methods.name: enyo.path.addPaths
methods.description: Adds path aliases for resource resolution.
